in_arabic.name: حريبة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الحرة أو المعتزة بنفسها

in_english.name: Huraiba
in_english.long_meaning: Huraiba is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from 'haraba' which means 'free' or 'independent'. The name connotes self-respect, purity, and dignity. In Islamic tradition, it signifies a woman who maintains her honor and integrity. The etymology of Huraiba can be traced back to the Arabic root 'h-r-b' which is also related to concepts of freedom and self-reliance. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a woman of strong character and moral values.
